exposure: Prenatal supplementation with EPA-rich fish oil
Prenatal supplementation with DHA-rich fish oil
Prenatal supplementation with soy oil placebo
cohort: The study included 84 mother-infant pairs who were part of a randomized controlled trial of prenatal supplementation.
finding: Contrary to the hypothesis, prenatal omega-3 fatty acid supplementation (EPA and DHA) was associated with a significantly increased risk (ORs 5.0-5.8) of offspring eczema at 36 months compared to soy oil placebo.
